transcript.answer: No, not any more. The auto-merge loop originally did fix red pull requests. PR #3320 added an `auto-merge-fix` agent that handled red CI, conflicts and open review threads, with three rounds at most. PR #3376 (merged 2026-10-23) removed that agent and its fix stations. `auto-merge.yaml` is now `await-merge → approve → done`. `decideMergeReady` answers only ready or wait, so a red, conflicted or thread-blocked pull request is waited out. Auto merge waits and approves. Keeping a pull request mergeable is now the job of the loop that opened it. The implementation loop does this through `await-pr` and sync/fix routing, plus upkeep runs for settled loop pull requests that are behind, conflicted or red.
